uploaded_reference.title: NCCN Guidelines for Patients: Brain Cancer Glioma
uploaded_reference.based_on: NCCN Central Nervous System Cancers Version 3.2026, August 17, 2026
uploaded_reference.source: User-supplied PDF read locally; not redistributed

mapping.decision: Original paraphrase; no copied artwork or universal prognosis.

mapping.concepts: Neurological examination, MRI, pathology, IDH, 1p/19q, MGMT
mapping.decision: Distinguishes tissue markers, MRI and medicine-safety blood tests. No single biomarker authorises treatment. No generic metastatic stage label applied.

mapping.concepts: Surgery, radiotherapy, chemotherapy, trials and multidisciplinary care
mapping.decision: Irish NCCP schedule and eligibility control; no imported US access or treatment recommendations.

mapping.concepts: Different glioma subtypes, treatment sequence, follow-up and quality of life
mapping.decision: No automatic subtype expansion or US follow-up interval copied into mandatory regimen testing.
Explains uncertainty and need for clinical review; does not reassure away new neurological symptoms.

mapping.concepts: Supportive care, carers, emotional/practical needs, future wishes
mapping.decision: Original patient questions adapted to Irish services; no US legal, insurance or hospice eligibility rules copied.

regimen_rule_authority: Current official NCCP PDFs; current lomustine, Avastin and cisplatin product information provide separately identified safety supplements and source-conflict review.
reproduction: Original wording using retained SACTCheck anatomy; no NCCN figures or pages reproduced; no NCCN endorsement claimed.
clv_scope: 00806 is a medulloblastoma/embryonal-tumour regimen. Uploaded glioma guide used only for general symptom, rehabilitation, carer and shared-decision concepts; not diagnostic markers, eligibility, schedule, efficacy, scan intervals or treatment recommendations.

additional_patient_reference.title: NCI medulloblastoma patient education
additional_patient_reference.scope: Original explanation of disease/risk/molecular grouping and brain/spine multimodal care; Irish eligibility and prescriptions remain NCCP-specific.
